resources.string: Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey filled with excitement, and suspense.

Click the countdown number to randomly decrease it. Every third turn increases the drinking counter. If the number hits zero, the loser drinks the total! However, there is so much more to this game than that.
Before we begin, we have to create your character! \n\n You can either take a photo of yourself, or if you\'re having a bad hair day, you can draw your character.
On top of creating your player, you can choose a class which grants you a perk in the game. This can range from skipping your turn, to making quizzes easier.
The aim of the game is not to get to 0. Tip ~ The lower the number, the faster the game!
Within the settings you will find options to set wildcard limits, disable wildcards, make the quiz multi-choice or verbal answers, change the max losing drinking number, and so on.
Let me introduce you to the two main buttons. \n\n First, there\'s the \'Generate\' button, which will randomly choose a number between 0 and the number on screen.
This button throws tasks, quizzes, and challenges your way. Fail or skip them, and you\'ll have to take a drink. If you succeed, you can make someone else drink.
If you get a quiz, and get the right answer, your turn is skipped and you can hand out a drink.
This category will provide you with something to do. It might be an impersonation, or it might be a drink. Who knows really!
Like truth or dare, but bewared, some of these are quite challenging!
Catastrophes change the game for better or for worse (mostly for worse hehe). For example, it might increase the drinking number, or it may remove wildcards. Who knows..
Once a player hits that dreaded zero, they\'re the loser and must face the consequence of drinking the amount on the counter!

You\'ve completed a round of High To Low! If the thrill of the game hasn\'t quenched your thirst for excitement, why not play it again, and again, and again. Literally do whatever you want, you\'re a free person so live your gorgeous life.
I hope you enjoy our game!
